name: Sainath
headline: Java backend systems and applied AI workflows.
intro: Senior software engineer with 10+ years building production Java services and distributed systems. Specializing in AI-assisted workflows, backend architecture, and operational automation.

specialties.title: 🤖 Retrieval-grounded AI systems
specialties.description: Building AI experiences that answer from policy, claims context, and operational evidence instead of free-form guesses.

specialties.title: ⚙️ Java backend systems
specialties.description: Designing resilient services and event-driven architectures for complex, long-running processes.

specialties.title: 🧰 Engineering platforms
specialties.description: Building internal tools and data foundations that make teams faster and production operations clearer.

selectedWork.title: 🧠 RAG-powered claims guidance assistant
selectedWork.problem: Operational teams needed fast, grounded answers that drew on plan rules, policy documents, and claim context without overloading reviewers with raw search work.
selectedWork.approach: Built a retrieval-first workflow that assembled the right evidence from healthcare policies and claim records, then used Gemini and structured orchestration to produce reviewable recommendations with traceable citations.
selectedWork.focus: Grounding the model in trusted source material, keeping outputs explainable, and making human review the safety layer for edge cases.
selectedWork.stack: RAG · Gemini · Vertex AI SDK · Google ADK · Healthcare rules

selectedWork.title: 🤖 AI-assisted business-rule automation
selectedWork.problem: Complex business rules and exception paths required consistent evaluation without removing human review from ambiguous decisions.
selectedWork.approach: Combined Gemini models, Google ADK, and configured rules to evaluate cases, execute eligible workflows, and route exceptions to a review experience.
selectedWork.focus: Grounding model decisions in explicit rules, designing safe workflow boundaries, and preserving operational visibility.
selectedWork.stack: Gemini · Vertex AI SDK · Google ADK · React

selectedWork.title: ⚡ Event-driven Java service platform
selectedWork.problem: Long-running business processes needed reliable asynchronous coordination across independently deployed services.
selectedWork.approach: Designed Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs around message-driven workflows, with Kafka and RabbitMQ handling event synchronization and reliable processing.
selectedWork.focus: Service boundaries, asynchronous failure handling, reusable foundations, and production observability.
selectedWork.stack: Java · Spring Boot · Kafka · RabbitMQ · Kubernetes

selectedWork.title: 🧰 Developer operations platform
selectedWork.problem: Operational scripts for remediation, test data, and support tasks were fragmented and difficult to discover or run consistently.
selectedWork.approach: Unified the workflows behind a Python and Flask interface with reusable execution patterns, rollback support, and audit-friendly operations.
selectedWork.focus: Reducing operational friction, making risky actions reversible, and giving engineers a clear path from diagnosis to resolution.

selectedWork.title: 🕸️ Network graph and pathfinding service
selectedWork.problem: Provisioning workflows needed to understand relationships between network devices and identify viable routes through a complex topology.
selectedWork.approach: Modeled devices and relationships in Neo4j and exposed a REST API for shortest-path queries using Yen's K-Shortest path algorithm.
selectedWork.focus: Choosing graph representations, exposing useful traversal APIs, and making network relationships actionable for service operations.
selectedWork.stack: Neo4j · Java · Spring Boot · REST APIs · Graph algorithms

Built a Python/Flask developer-tools platform that unified scripts for data remediation, test-data generation, and production support.

Resolved Fortify vulnerabilities and implemented transaction locking to prevent race conditions during device activation.
Integrated SAML single sign-on for internal and external identity providers.
